sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Implement Full Tweet CRUD with Thread Support

```python
class TweetService:
    def create(self, user_id, content, reply_to=None): pass
    def delete(self, user_id, tweet_id): pass
    def get_thread(self, tweet_id) -> list: pass  # Full thread
    def get_replies(self, tweet_id, limit=20): pass
```

### Exercise 2: Build a URL Shortener Service

```python
class URLShortener:
    def shorten(self, long_url) -> str: pass  # t.co/xyz
    def resolve(self, short_url) -> str: pass
    def get_analytics(self, short_url) -> dict: pass  # Click counts
```

### Exercise 3: Implement User Timeline with Pagination

```python
class PaginatedTimeline:
    def get_page(self, user_id, cursor=None, limit=20) -> dict: pass
    # Returns: {"tweets": [...], "next_cursor": "...", "has_more": bool}
```

```python

```
